player_prompt.intro:
Nang amyu {player_id} SimpleTak na.
Board na, nang amyu ga {player_stone} shi nang amyu ga opponent ga {opponent_stone} shi.

Nang amyu ga turn na, empty cell kaba (numbered index na) chyeju.
Example, '[12]' nang amyu ga cell 12 na ga stone chyeju.

Nang amyu ga objective na, nang amyu ga stone ga continuous path chyeju, board ga two opposite edges (top-to-bottom shi left-to-right) ga connect chyeju.
